test_cases.name: stops_when_spec_not_approved
assertions: Reads the spec and checks its approval status before listing any candidate decision
Stops and points the user to /spec when the spec is missing or not approved
Does NOT create any file under docs/physarum/adr/
Does NOT invoke writing-plans

test_cases.name: no_adr_for_easy_to_reverse_choices
test_cases.input: Spec đã approve, chỉ thêm 1 endpoint GET /health và đổi tên một biến config. Chạy /adr xem có cần ADR không.
assertions: Lists candidate decisions from the spec, then applies all three filter conditions (hard to reverse, surprising without context, real trade-off) to each
Writes zero ADR files because no candidate passes the filter
Appends a `## Decisions` section to the spec containing a line `- No ADR needed: <one-line reason>`
Moves failing candidates to `- Deferred: <decision> — <revisit condition>` lines instead of an ADR

test_cases.name: writes_adr_with_template_and_next_number
test_cases.input: Spec đã approve chọn Postgres JSONB thay vì bảng riêng cho audit log, khó đổi sau. docs/physarum/adr/ đã có 0001-use-fastapi.md và 0003-oauth-cookie-host-scoped.md. Viết ADR.
assertions: Inspects docs/physarum/adr/ for the existing numbering scheme before writing
Creates docs/physarum/adr/0004-<kebab-case-slug>.md (highest existing number + 1, same extension and filename pattern)
ADR contains the headings Context, Decision, Alternatives considered, Consequences and the fields Status, Date, Spec, Binds, Prevents
Alternatives considered lists at least one rejected option with a `Rejected:` reason
Sets `Status: proposed` on creation, not `accepted`
Does NOT introduce a second numbering or format scheme

test_cases.name: coaching_mode_for_load_bearing_call
test_cases.input: Spec approve rồi, cần chọn giữa event sourcing và CRUD cho module orders. Chạy /adr, lane T3.
assertions: Presents 2-3 realistic alternatives with a recommendation before writing the ADR
Waits for the user to choose the load-bearing option
Does NOT silently decide the load-bearing call
In Fast mode, marks each unconfirmed choice with an `[ASSUMPTION]` tag in the draft

test_cases.name: self_check_before_asking_accept
test_cases.input: Draft ADR 0005 còn một dòng [ASSUMPTION] và không có Alternatives. Hoàn tất và xin accept.
assertions: Runs the self-check before asking the user to accept
Resolves or removes every `[ASSUMPTION]` tag before asking for accept
Adds at least one rejected alternative with a reason
Fills both `Binds` and `Prevents`
Checks the ADR does not contradict the spec or earlier ADRs

test_cases.name: supersede_instead_of_rewrite
test_cases.input: Quyết định ở ADR 0002 (dùng SQLite) đã đổi sang Postgres. Cập nhật ADR.
assertions: Creates a NEW ADR with the next number and a `Supersedes: 0002` line
Edits ADR 0002 only to set `Status: superseded by NNNN`, leaving the rest of its text unchanged
Does NOT delete or rewrite ADR 0002 body

test_cases.name: stops_at_accept_and_does_not_plan
test_cases.input: Tôi accept ADR 0004. Tiếp tục luôn.
assertions: Sets `Status: accepted` in each ADR the user accepted
Ensures the spec's `## Decisions` section contains `- ADR: docs/physarum/adr/0004-<slug>.md (accepted)`
Stops after recording acceptance
Does NOT invoke writing-plans and does NOT edit code; tells the user to run /plan <spec> as the next step

test_cases.name: creates_adr_dir_lazily
test_cases.input: Spec approve có quyết định chọn message broker (khó đổi). Repo chưa có docs/physarum/adr/. Viết ADR.
assertions: Creates docs/physarum/adr/ lazily
Names the first file 0001-<slug>.md
Does NOT write to docs/adr/ or a per-feature folder
